title: Discovering quasars across cosmic time
text: We identify and characterize quasars across a wide range of redshifts, from the nearby universe to the cosmic dawn, using multi-wavelength data from large-area surveys. This work builds a more complete view of quasar populations and reveals previously overlooked or rare quasar types.

caption: Observed spectra of high-redshift quasars

title: Tracking quasar demographics over time
text: We investigate how the number density, luminosity, and spectral properties of quasars change over billions of years. By constructing quasar luminosity functions and tracking their redshift evolution, we aim to reveal the physical processes behind the rise and fall of quasar activity.

caption: Quasar luminosity function at z ~ 5

title: Co-evolution of black holes and host galaxies
text: We study the co-evolution of supermassive black holes and their host galaxies by combining infrared, optical, and submillimeter survey data. This lets us trace black hole growth alongside star formation and structural transformation during key cosmic epochs.
